market.selection: first complete market capture for this symbol

time_semantics.observation_timestamps: Actual UTC capture starts retained exactly.
time_semantics.chart_labels: Retained verbatim with unknown timezone; no displayed chart label is represented as UTC or Beijing event time.
time_semantics.bar_status: Completed/running status follows chart sequence. Absolute UTC opening/closing times cannot be established.
time_semantics.synchronization: Asynchronous public UI observations, not synchronized exchange events.

open_interest.selection_note: Latest verified adjacent displayed 08:00 and 09:00 points; each freshly read this sampling window. Earlier 07:00/08:00 loading-period reads remain raw evidence.

candles.numeric_change_definition: 100 * (close - open) / open. UI CHANGE retained separately.
candles.volume_precision_note: K/M/B-expanded values are rounded UI displays; unlabelled trailing indicators are not volume observations.

candle_consistency.comparison: taker buy plus sell minus same displayed-hour completed candle volume
candle_consistency.rounding_assumption: Half of the final displayed K/M/B decimal increment.
candle_consistency.limitation: Matching chart-local labels do not establish a verified UTC interval. Values are retained without forcing agreement.

historical_chart_points.limitation: Chart-local history timestamp only; UTC settlement time is not established.

latest_displayed_historical_point.limitation: Chart-local history timestamp only; UTC settlement time is not established.

funding.historical_note: History chart point is separate from current predicted rate; account payment and UTC settlement time are not established.

quantity_oi_abs_change_at_least_5pct.basis: Adjacent displayed hourly base-asset quantities, not USDT notional.

closed_1h_volume_and_price.basis: Completed displayed 08:00 bar versus arithmetic mean of six preceding completed 02:00 through 07:00 base volumes. Both conditions must hold.

reliable_mark_abs_change_at_least_10pct.basis: Same-contract public mark field in adjacent actual UTC sampling windows; elapsed time disclosed, no rescaling.

limitations: Signed-out public rendered UI only; values can refresh asynchronously.
Chart timezone unknown; no UTC/Beijing event-time conversion.
Running candle OHLC and volume may momentarily be internally inconsistent and are excluded from trigger evaluation.
Three named contracts only, not a whole-market sample.

transient_timeframe_capture_exclusions.reason: Immediate interval switch showed new 4H selection before candle volume refreshed; numeric running 4h uses later verified capture9.

raw_capture_index_scope: Global indices in this 60-capture sampling batch; only this symbol's public captures are included below.
